json.reasoning: The request pins exactly two shots of a locked camera watching rain on a night bus window; the director note preferring three is lower priority and cannot override the explicit count. Nothing requests speech, music, or visible lettering, and music is explicitly forbidden, so the track carries only diegetic rain and bus ambience. Shot 1 establishes the full window surface with beads and streaked reflections; Shot 2 cuts to a tighter insert where a single droplet gathers and runs, giving a distinct change rather than repeating the opening. Both camera moves are static with empty amplitude and speed, and both shots exceed 1200ms within the 8000ms target.

shots.action: A locked view holds on a bus window at night, the glass filling most of the frame. Raindrops bead and quiver across the surface while blurred streetlights and neon reflections smear into slow, wavering streaks behind them; the dark bus interior falls away at the soft edges of the pane. Droplets gather, hesitate, then begin to slide in thin, uneven tracks, shifting the reflected lights as they move.
subjects: blurred nighttime streetlights and neon reflections
sync_sound: soft patter of rain on glass
shots.what_changes: The still bead pattern begins to break into sliding trails that distort the reflected lights.

shots.action: The shot cuts to an extreme close view of the same rain-streaked pane. A single large droplet trembles at the center, draws in smaller beads as it swells, then breaks free and runs downward in a wavering line, clearing a narrow path through the condensation. Behind it, a washed-out streetlight reflection stretches and thins as the drop passes, while finer droplets continue to creep and merge around it.
subjects: single large rain droplet on glass
stretched streetlight reflection behind the glass
sync_sound: close, delicate ticking of droplets on glass
shots.what_changes: The central droplet merges with neighbors, breaks loose, and carves a clear running trail through the condensation.
